name: central-manutencao
description: Central de Manutenção — solicitação e acompanhamento de RMAs

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @central/api && npm run build -w @central/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev:all
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @central/api
